Radio control can be setup through rigctld. Note: RadioMail requires a running version of the VARA modem to be available on your connected computer. STATION DIRECTORY・Station details are automatically retrieved from Winlink and organized by proximity based on your current location. Add custom stations for peer-to-peer connections. Note: Peer-to-peer connections are outbound only.

FAVORITES LIST・Add stations to your favorites list and quickly access them by modes and bands when ready to initiate a connection.
